desc: Ideation complete: reduce the problem to minimizing over column masks c the sum over row masks m of freq[m] * min(popcount(m xor c), W - popcount(m xor c)).

Implement the complete Python solution using frequency aggregation and an optimized XOR Fast Walsh-Hadamard Transform, including input parsing, kernel construction, convolution, normalization, and printing the minimum.
Validate the implementation against the provided samples and edge cases such as H=1, W=1, all rows identical, and worst-case W=18 performance.
